# Local video editing

Work with the media the user identifies in the current workspace. Build an edit list with source filenames, in/out times, output order, aspect ratio, and caption/audio decisions. Use an existing project editor or FFmpeg if installed. Keep source files intact and export to a separate path. Inspect duration, dimensions, audio, and playback before delivering the export. If the renderer is unavailable, provide the edit list and identify the missing tool.
